purpose: Goal 20R-V3-R1 attachment sections 1-2: preserve and retire the single blocked pre-freeze V3 candidate; it must never be promoted to formal Validation.
retirement_reasons: SAMPLE_ID_NAMESPACE_COLLISION: 120/120 sample IDs byte-identical to Validation V2 (decision-bench-v2-val-*); epoch identity not distinct.
CROSS_EPOCH_SAME_SLOT_NEAR_DUPLICATE_TARGET_FAILURE: V3-vs-V2 8-gram Jaccard max 0.7695 (3 pairs >= 0.75, 32 pairs >= 0.5, all same-(tt,idx) slots) violates the frozen design target max < 0.4.

disposition.note: Files preserved byte-identically on disk; no normalization, no line-ending or BOM changes; not part of any V3-R1 freeze chain.

superseded_by.procedure: Goal 20R-V3-R1 epoch-distinct namespace (decision-bench-v3-val-*) + seed-aware same-slot diversification under a newly frozen generation procedure; single V3-R1 generation after generator commit; seed derived mechanically (SHA256(method_commit || generator_commit || "goal20-validation-v3-r1")) with no seed search.
